channel.title: Tech Kadak — naye free apps
channel.description: Paid app ka FREE jawab — roz naye free apps, AI tools & GitHub gems, simple Hinglish mein.

item.title: LibreTorrent
item.description: Ad-free torrent client: magnet links, sequential download, sirf Wi-Fi pe download ka option.

item.title: Joplin
item.description: Notes + to-do app (Markdown) phone aur PC dono pe; Dropbox/OneDrive se free sync, end-to-end encryption.

item.title: TrackerControl
item.description: Dekho kaunsi app chupke se kis company ko data bhej rahi hai, aur trackers block karo — bina root.

item.title: Logseq
item.description: Outliner notes jo files tumhare device pe rakhta hai: daily journal, linked notes, graph view — padhai notes ke liye.

item.title: Exodus Privacy
item.description: Phone me installed har app ki report: usme kaunse trackers aur kaunsi permissions hain.

item.title: qBittorrent
item.description: Ad-free torrent client PC ke liye: search, sequential download, speed limits.

item.title: QuickDic
item.description: Offline dictionary: bahut saari languages ke dictionaries (Wiktionary se) bina internet ke.

item.title: DIKSHA
item.description: NCERT/CBSE ki official learning app: textbook ke QR code scan karo aur us chapter ki video, notes, practice.

item.title: calibre
item.description: E-book library manager: EPUB/PDF/MOBI convert, e-book reader, metadata aur covers.

item.title: Insular
item.description: Apps ko alag 'work profile' box me rakho: same app ka doosra account (clone) ya faltu apps freeze.

item.title: Aves Libre
item.description: Gallery app: photos/videos, map pe photos kahan khinchi, GIF/motion photos, photo ka metadata dekho.

item.title: Rufus
item.description: Windows/Linux ki bootable USB pendrive banao — naya OS install karne ke liye.

item.title: Etar Calendar
item.description: Calendar app clean design ke saath: phone me jo bhi calendar account hai (Google bhi) wo dikhata hai, widget, no ads.

item.title: Ventoy
item.description: Ek pendrive me kai ISO files (Windows, Linux) daalo aur boot menu se chuno — har baar format nahi.

item.title: Saber
item.description: Handwriting notes app: stylus ya ungli se notes likho, PDF pe annotate karo. Notes encrypt karke sync ka option.

item.title: Next Player
item.description: Material You design wala video player: subtitles, gestures, PiP, folders view — no ads.

item.title: Microsoft PowerToys
item.description: Windows ke liye power tools: kisi bhi screen se text copy (OCR), colour picker, bulk rename, window layouts.

item.title: Gramophone
item.description: Offline music player clean design ke saath: synced lyrics (LRC), folders, playlists.

item.title: Everything
item.description: Windows me koi bhi file naam se 1 second me dhoondo — Windows search se kahin tez.

item.title: Retro Music Player
item.description: Stylish offline music player: themes, lyrics, equalizer, sleep timer.

item.title: mpv-android
item.description: Powerful video player: lagbhag har format, subtitles, speed control, gestures — bina ads.

item.title: Flameshot
item.description: Screenshot lo aur turant arrows, text, blur, highlight laga do — notes/tutorials ke liye.

item.title: DigiLocker
item.description: Government ki official app: Aadhaar, PAN, DL, CBSE marksheet/certificates digital — originals jitne valid.

item.title: Just (Video) Player
item.description: Simple video player: double-tap se seek, swipe se volume/brightness, subtitles, picture-in-picture.

item.title: ShareX
item.description: Windows pe screenshot, screen recording, GIF banana, text OCR — sab ek free tool me.

item.title: Briar
item.description: Bina internet ke chat: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi se paas wale dosto ko message, internet ho to Tor se. Na phone number, na central server.

item.title: VSCodium
item.description: VS Code ka open-source build bina Microsoft telemetry ke — same editor, same feel.

item.title: FairEmail
item.description: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo — saare email ek inbox me, privacy ke saath: tracking images block, phishing warning.

item.title: Thonny
item.description: Python seekhne ke liye sabse simple IDE: Python saath me aata hai, step-by-step debugger dikhata hai code kaise chalta hai.

item.title: DuckDuckGo Browser
item.description: Privacy browser: trackers block karta hai, ek Fire button se saara browsing data turant saaf.
